claim: A council round is distilled at close into the target proto-belief: settled decisions become its Open items and Mint-manifest rows, rejected alternatives fold into a dated rejected-because block, and the raw exchange is referenced by `commit:`/PR and never copied into the document. The distilled plan, not the transcript, is what an implementer receives.

evidence.detail: Staged and grounded in the council-mechanism proto-belief document: distillation keeps the proto-belief the single authoritative surface (one document per separable matter) and leaves the raw exchange cited, not copied - the anti-digest discipline applied to review rounds.

Demonstrated by this rule's own founding round: the route-tagging audit's findings were dispositioned into route-tagging.md's Audit dispositions block and the full report relocated to PR #20 as a comment, cited, never committed.

Session thread retro-pair (cb:b507): the minting session's finalized thread persists at the cited document - the A2 enactment that minted the four council-mechanism rows through clean preflights alongside the route-tagging enactment, and held council-mechanism live in the nursery (rows planted, /council build and Open strands unresolved) on the cb:b569 graduation call.
